name: dsh-tripipelines
description: Three-tier model collaboration plugin for DeepSeek Harness: L1 coordinator (any model the user picks) -> L2 module leads (model configured per module) -> L3 executors (local engine over HTTP, or a cloud provider in agent mode), with strict adjacency, long-lived L2, per-task acceptance, quality gates, per-workspace run state, per-module work directories, and a live GUI status board.
author: merhentz
